components.name: prewarmer (FaaS #1)
components.what: Cloud Run function (2nd gen, Node 24) that raises service-level minimum instances of aforo-gateway and aforo-queue before a sales window opens and lowers them after.
components.serves: Removes container cold start at the opening spike (E-01) while letting the entry path scale to zero the rest of the time (E-07). Buyers see nothing different.

why.note: Chosen as FaaS #1: realizes a designed Entrega 3 tactic instead of a component added only to comply.
Tactic 'pre-warming per sales window': opening time comes from the catalog's EventPublished.
Amended by D-21: Terraform ignores gateway/queue service-level min_instance_count; this function owns it.
No timers or sleeps: Cloud Tasks holds the delay, the queue is the state.

Env: TARGET_SERVICES aforo-gateway:1,aforo-queue:1, BASELINE_MIN_INSTANCES 0, PREWARM_LEAD_SECONDS 600, PREWARM_HOLD_SECONDS 3600, TASKS_QUEUE prewarm-windows.

components.name: reservation-expiry
